components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #153B27; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0F2D1E; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #153B27; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Crimson Button (Portal)
components.css: .ds-btn-crimson { background: #7F1D1D; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-crimson:hover { background: #661717; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-crimson:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-crimson:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7F1D1D; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #44403C; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid #E7E5E4; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F5F5F4; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #153B27; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Chip (active)
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(236,253,245,0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(5,150,105,0.3); color: #153B27; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #153B27; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #153B27; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-pageheader { background: #F6F5F0; padding: 56px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(231,229,228,0.8); } .ds-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #7F1D1D; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-rule { width: 28px; height: 2px; background: #7F1D1D; } .ds-pageheader-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px; } .ds-h1 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(2.125rem, 5vw, 3.25rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #14291D; margin: 0; } .ds-rail { max-width: 32rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.68; color: #78716C; text-align: right; margin: 0; }

components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 14px 24px; background: rgba(12,25,18,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 24px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-nav-links a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-portal { background: #7F1D1D; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-portal:hover { background: #661717; }

narrative.overview: The University of Swat presents itself as a dignified, modern public research university rooted in the Swat Valley — a landscape defined by Gandharan Buddhist heritage, alpine ecology, and a 1.2 MW solar park that made it the first 100% solar-powered public university in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The design system turns that institutional reality into a visual language: warm, spacious, editorial pages with a scholarly serif voice, restrained forest/crimson/gold accents, and photography-led storytelling.
keyCharacteristics: Warm alabaster page canvas (never pure white) with deep charcoal ink.
Scholarly serif display paired with a crisp geometric UI sans.
Forest green = academic action; crimson = statutory authority; gold = heritage.
1360px reading grid with generous section rhythm (80px desktop).
Cards are editorial surfaces: white, hairline stone borders, soft shadows.
Real institutional photography over stock clichés.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Forest green and crimson are chosen, not scattered. The primary accent appears on ≤10% of any given screen — usually one button, one active tab, or one eyebrow.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: Pages never rest on #ffffff as the canvas; white is reserved for card surfaces, and the surrounding canvas is always warm alabaster.

rules.name: The 70ch Rule
rules.body: Reading paragraphs never exceed 65–75 characters per line.

rules.name: The No-Single-Italic Rule
rules.body: Headings never contain a single italic word.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to hover, focus, or state.

rules.name: The Gold-Cap Rule
rules.body: The only place gold is allowed as a border is the hero card top-edge; elsewhere gold reads as text/icon.

dos: Do use the split header pattern for every hub page.
Do use real institutional photography: campus, leadership, department labs, news events.
Do keep reading blocks ≤70ch and body copy at stone-600 or darker.
Do reserve gold for heritage accents; forest for actions; crimson for statutory, deadline, and portal moments.
Do animate transform/opacity only; hover lifts ≤2px; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use pure white as a page canvas; warm alabaster is the only page background.
Don't scatter accents; one forest/crimson moment per screen.
Don't invent metrics, testimonials, or staff bios.
Don't use gradient text, emoji icons, or SaaS-style pastel gradients.
Don't stack identical three-column card grids on every page.
